event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,486 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 79 prior macro-attempts in this family and 663 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0181/micro-0006 at 1486 parameters and 99.010000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0181/micro-0007 (discard, 98.980000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the tied input/output token matrix: union groups represented by flattened coordinates 16 and 18, whose values are 0.0941890925 and 0.0944710970 (difference 2.820e-04), using a multiplicity-weighted mean and one integer reconstruction map. Hypothesis: token scalars have a different sensitivity structure from the positional table and this minimum-distortion union preserves qualification while yielding 1,485 parameters. It is more informative than the next eligible token union (difference 2.874e-04) because it is the least perturbing test at this new tensor site.
